scope: Linux x86-64 CPU on one host, two trusted IPv4 loopback workers, two F32 ADD graphs, no checkpoint

toolchain.configuration: built-in GGML CPU and RPC, static libraries, no native tuning or RDMA

fixture.buffer_accounting: GGML tensor allocation size for each stage; excludes allocator overhead, process resident memory and TCP framing
fixture.worker_lifecycle: Each remote run starts two fresh CPU workers with the matching upstream test shell, model cache disabled, both bound to 127.0.0.1. The shell terminates its children on exit. Each arithmetic run has a new client process and a 30 s supervisor timeout.
